# E02: Ancient crust: sample histories, not the age of a state

**Window:** Precambrian; local numerical boundaries pending specialist review.

**Question:** Which minerals and rocks now within the territory preserve the earliest dated processes?

## Evidence presently available in this seed

The Trivandrum Block paper and the later peninsular-crust paper are relevant starting points. They require sample-by-sample interpretation; the 2006 paper has an erratum whose contents remain unread.

Source routes: [S002](../sources/S002.md), [S003](../sources/S003.md), [S006](../sources/S006.md).

## What this does not establish

An inherited zircon core, a crystallization age, a metamorphic overgrowth and a model crust-extraction age answer different questions. None alone dates a continuously exposed geographical landmass. Do not publish an oldest-rock ranking from an article title.

## Research tasks

- [ ] Retrieve S002 together with S003 and register every correction.
- [ ] Build a sample table: locality, coordinates with access restrictions, mineral, analytical spot, method, uncertainty, interpretation and laboratory provenance.
- [ ] Check S006 full text and later responses; distinguish Hadean ancestry claims from intact-rock formation.
- [ ] Keep samples outside the scope as geological context, not local finds.
